translations.answer: First, connect the robot to the Jetson and verify the correct network card; compile the SDK2 official example; run the read-only robot-state example to validate CycloneDDS and state reception; only then attempt control writing. This separates environment/network issues from control logic and reduces risk during initial debugging.
translations.applicability: Applies to Unitree SDK2/SDK2 Python G1 integration.
translations.credibility.rationale: Environmental, processing steps, and results have engineering records, but formal cross-validation or independent replication is missing.
translations.details.attempts.0: Maintain the boom but ensure feet are grounded before activating balance.
translations.details.attempts.1: Stop tasks, fix the boom, go to idle, and cool down externally before investigating the root cause.
translations.details.attempts.2: Keep the vendor image, install the SDK according to official documentation.
translations.details.attempts.3: Compile and run the read-only state example.
translations.details.diagnostics.0: Check status, alarms, temperature, network, and calibration in the Explore App.
translations.details.diagnostics.1: Check interfaces and SDK2 examples after SSH, read state first, then write control.
translations.details.environments.0: Unitree G1 EDU; onboard Jetson development computing unit; SDK2 expects Ubuntu 20.04, GCC 9.4, CMake 3.10+.
translations.details.limits.0: The post is a personal experience summary; external fans are emergency measures and cannot replace thermal source or load diagnosis.
translations.details.outcomes.0: The author provides a safe and debugging order but lacks temperature curves or independent replication experiments.
translations.details.problem_statements.0: Why do the legs of G1 move violently when it is in balance or walking mode?
translations.details.problem_statements.1: How should one handle thermal warnings during operation?
translations.details.problem_statements.2: Why should one avoid arbitrarily re-flashing the onboard Jetson?
translations.details.problem_statements.3: What is the minimum test that should be run first when integrating SDK2?
translations.details.safety_notes.0: Always retain the boom, clear the area, establish emergency stop path and low-risk initial pose; control examples must be validated in read-only state before gradually releasing control.
translations.details.suspected_causes.0: The balance strategy assumptions regarding contact and state are invalid.
translations.details.suspected_causes.1: Continuous motion causes local motor thermal accumulation.
translations.details.suspected_causes.2: The Jetson image and robot internal software stack are not synchronized.
translations.details.suspected_causes.3: Network interface or DDS configuration errors.
translations.details.symptoms.0: The balance strategy still attempts to find support and drive the legs when the feet are not grounded.
translations.details.symptoms.1: A loud thermal warning is heard during operation or policy execution.
translations.details.symptoms.2: It is difficult to distinguish between network, DDS, and code issues when the SDK example fails.
translations.media_summaries.0: All key content of the X Article is in the visible main text; the images mainly showcase the G1 body and protection, and do not serve as evidence for logs or parameters.
